title: Python Developer
description: Comprehensive directed learning tree to master Python, from basic syntax to advanced applications, frameworks, Data Science, and Machine Learning.

nodes.title: Foundations
nodes.description: Core Python environment setup, basic syntax, primitive data types, variables, and operators.

children.title: Introduction to Python & Installation
children.description: Understanding Python 3 execution model, CPython interpreter, and installation.

children.title: Python Interpreter & IDEs (VS Code, PyCharm, Jupyter)
children.description: Configuring IDEs, REPL environment, and running Python scripts.

children.title: Basic Syntax & Variables
children.description: Dynamic typing, variable declaration, naming conventions, and memory references.

children.title: Data Types (int, float, str, bool)
children.description: Built-in primitive types, type conversion, and type checking with type().

children.title: Operators
children.description: Arithmetic, assignment, comparison, logical, bitwise, identity, and membership operators.

children.title: Input & Output
children.description: Reading console input via input(), print() formatting, f-strings, and string formatting.

children.title: Comments & Docstrings
children.description: Single-line comments, multi-line strings, and docstring documentation standards.

nodes.title: Core Python
nodes.description: Control structures, functions, parameter passing, built-in data structures, list comprehensions, and error handling.

children.title: Control Flow (if-else, loops)
children.description: Conditional statements, for loops, while loops, break, continue, and pass statements.

children.title: Functions & Parameters
children.description: Function definition, default arguments, positional vs keyword arguments, *args and **kwargs.

children.title: Data Structures (Lists, Tuples, Sets, Dicts)
children.description: Indexing, slicing, mutability vs immutability, dict lookups, and set operations.

children.title: String Manipulation
children.description: String methods, concatenation, slicing, splitting, joining, and regex basics.

children.title: List Comprehensions
children.description: Concise syntax for creating lists, nested list comprehensions, and generator expressions.

children.title: Recursion
children.description: Base case, recursive call stacks, tail recursion, and memoization techniques.

children.title: Error Handling (try-except-finally)
children.description: Catching exceptions, raise keyword, custom exceptions, and cleanup with finally.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming
nodes.description: Classes, object instantiation, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, and dunder magic methods.

children.title: Classes & Objects
children.description: Class attributes, instance variables, self parameter, and instantiation.

children.title: Constructors & Destructors
children.description: __init__ constructor initializer, __del__ destructor, and object lifecycles.

children.title: Encapsulation
children.description: Private fields (_protected, __private name mangling), getters, setters, and @property.

children.title: Inheritance
children.description: Single, multiple, and multi-level inheritance, super() call, and MRO (Method Resolution Order).

children.title: Polymorphism
children.description: Duck typing, method overriding, dynamic binding, and operator overloading.

children.title: Abstract Classes & Interfaces (abc module)
children.description: Defining abstract methods using ABC, @abstractmethod decorator, and strict interfaces.

children.title: Magic Methods & Operator Overloading
children.description: Dunder methods (__str__, __repr__, __add__, __len__, __getitem__, __call__).

nodes.title: Intermediate Python
nodes.description: Modules, package management, virtual environments, iterators, generators, decorators, and file I/O.

children.title: Modules & Packages
children.description: Importing modules, custom packages, __init__.py, sys.path namespace resolution.

children.title: Virtual Environments (venv, pipenv)
children.description: Creating isolated Python environments, requirements.txt, pip, and dependency locking.

children.title: Iterators & Generators
children.description: __iter__, __next__, yield keyword, generator functions, lazy evaluation memory savings.

children.title: Decorators
children.description: Function wrappers, higher-order functions, functools.wraps, and parameterized decorators.

children.title: Context Managers
children.description: with statement, __enter__ and __exit__ methods, contextlib.contextmanager.

children.title: File Handling
children.description: Reading and writing files (txt, csv, json), file modes, buffering, and path management.

children.title: Regular Expressions (re module)
children.description: Pattern matching, search, match, findall, sub, regex flags, and groups.

nodes.title: Advanced Python
nodes.description: Functional programming paradigms, type hinting, metaclasses, concurrency models, and asynchronous programming.

children.title: Functional Programming (map, filter, reduce)
children.description: Pure functions, map(), filter(), functools.reduce(), and immutable data flows.

children.title: Lambda Functions
children.description: Anonymous inline functions, sorting keys, and callbacks.

children.title: Typing & Type Hints
children.description: PEP 484 type annotations, typing module (Union, Optional, Callable), static analysis with mypy.

children.title: Metaclasses
children.description: Understanding type, custom class creation hooks, __new__ vs __init__ in type instantiation.

children.title: Concurrency (Threading, Multiprocessing)
children.description: GIL limitations, threading module, multiprocessing module, concurrent.futures executor pool.

children.title: Async Programming (async/await, asyncio)
children.description: Event loops, coroutines, tasks, futures, non-blocking asynchronous I/O.

children.title: Memory Management & Garbage Collection
children.description: Reference counting, gc module, cyclic garbage collector, slot optimization (__slots__).

nodes.title: Popular Libraries & Frameworks
nodes.description: Data processing with NumPy & Pandas, visualization tools, web scraping, and web frameworks (Flask, Django, FastAPI).

children.title: NumPy
children.description: N-dimensional arrays, vectorization, broadcasting, matrix algebra, and indexing.

children.title: Pandas
children.description: DataFrames, Series, reading CSV/Excel/SQL, data filtering, grouping, and merging.

children.title: Matplotlib & Seaborn
children.description: Line plots, bar charts, histograms, scatter plots, subplots, and statistical plotting.

children.title: Requests (HTTP)
children.description: Sending GET/POST requests, session management, handling headers, JSON payloads, and response status.

children.title: BeautifulSoup & Scrapy (Web Scraping)
children.description: HTML DOM parsing, CSS selectors, XPath expressions, spider pipelines, and rate limiting.

children.title: Flask
children.description: Lightweight micro-framework, routing, request handling, Jinja2 templates, and REST APIs.

children.title: Django
children.description: Full-stack framework, MVT architecture, ORM models, admin panel, migrations, and auth system.

children.title: FastAPI
children.description: Modern async API framework, Pydantic validation, automatic OpenAPI Swagger docs, dependency injection.

nodes.title: Data Science & Machine Learning with Python
nodes.description: Data preprocessing, exploration, statistical modeling, and deep learning framework foundations.

children.title: Jupyter Notebooks
children.description: Interactive Python computing, markdown cells, magic commands, and notebook sharing.

children.title: Data Cleaning & Preprocessing
children.description: Handling missing values, outlier detection, feature scaling, one-hot encoding, and train-test splits.

children.title: Visualization with matplotlib/seaborn/plotly
children.description: Custom plot styling, interactive dashboards, and multi-variable analysis.

children.title: Scikit-learn
children.description: Supervised learning (regression, classification), unsupervised clustering (K-Means), and model evaluation metrics.

children.title: TensorFlow Basics
children.description: Tensors, computational graphs, Keras sequential API, and neural network training loops.

children.title: PyTorch Basics
children.description: Tensors, autograd automatic differentiation, nn.Module custom neural layers, and DataLoader pipelines.

nodes.title: Automation & Scripting
nodes.description: System task automation, filesystem manipulation, HTTP API orchestration, task scheduling, and web browser automation.

children.title: Working with OS & Filesystem (os, pathlib, shutil)
children.description: Directory traversal, file moving/copying, path manipulation with pathlib, and environment variables.

children.title: Automating Tasks with Python
children.description: File organizers, email alerts, PDF manipulation, and spreadsheet generation scripts.

children.title: APIs & HTTP Requests
children.description: Calling external REST APIs, API keys, JSON payload parsing, and error handling.

children.title: Web Automation with Selenium
children.description: WebDriver setup, element locator strategies, automated form filling, and page clicking automation.

children.title: Scheduling Scripts (cron, sched, apscheduler)
children.description: Background task scheduling, crontab integration, and periodic timer execution.
